Name: MuseDeck
Author: Mehmet Akif Acar
Description: Physical Human-in-the-Loop Mission Control, Multimodal UI Synthesizer & Telemetry Console for Meta Muse Code CLI, SAM 3.1, and Muse Spark.

Actions.Name: Agent Status
Actions.Tooltip: Dynamic visual status badge for Meta Muse Code (IDLE, PLANNING, WAITING_APPROVAL, EXECUTING, ERROR). Press to launch new session.

Actions.Name: Voice Input (⌥+V)
Actions.Tooltip: Physical toggle for Meta Muse Code CLI native voice input (Option+V).

Actions.Name: Prompt Snippets
Actions.Tooltip: Quick prompt snippets sub-dashboard (Be Honest, Don't Code, Show Options, Explain Why, Keep Short, No Tests, Go!).

Actions.Name: Struct Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Rewrites the current terminal input in-place into a clear, well-structured English prompt for an AI coding assistant.

Actions.Name: Muse Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Multi-session manager and drawer for Meta Muse Code terminals.

Actions.Name: Screenshot (SAM 3.1)
Actions.Tooltip: Interactive screen capture: snip UI region and insert image path directly into terminal.

Actions.Name: Image to Code
Actions.Tooltip: Dispatches SAM 3.1 segmented UI to Meta Muse Spark to synthesize production React & Tailwind CSS code.

Actions.Name: Video to Code
Actions.Tooltip: Record screen interaction or video and synthesize interactive animated UI code with Meta Muse Spark.

Actions.Name: Muse Settings
Actions.Tooltip: Living Meta Muse Mascot: Settings, Model Switch & Web Onboarding.

Actions.Name: AI Credits HUD
Actions.Tooltip: Real-time AI credit balance and model telemetry dashboard.

Actions.Name: Video Record
Actions.Tooltip: One-touch desktop interaction video recorder (5s). Captures reproducible UI bug flows and injects the video path at the terminal cursor.

Actions.Name: Muse Memory
Actions.Tooltip: Living project documentation and persistent AI context manager (SPEC, PLAN, ARCH, TODO, MUSE RULES).

Actions.Name: Muse Ops
Actions.Tooltip: Developer operations console: Fix Error, Refactor, Optimize, Explain, Find Symbol, Code Review, Run Tests, Run Build.

Actions.Name: Git Commands
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the Git Commands sub-dashboard (Status, Commit, Pull, Push, Diff, Stash, PR, Repo, Log).

Actions.Name: Halt / Stop
Actions.Tooltip: Emergency stop. Immediately halts child processes and cancels running agent workflows.
